subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'k' and 'i' (painting with water, stick-and-ink designs)

show.line: Let's write k and i. k has a tall line and a kick. i has a dot.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says k, as in kettle.
Trace k with your finger. A tall line down, then in and out.
Tap the letter that says i, as in insect.
Trace i with your finger. A short line down, then the dot.
Point to k. What sound does it make?

hints: k is tall and has a kick. i is short with a dot.
Start at the top. Go down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write i for insect.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A line down. Look, I wrote i!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the dot. i needs a dot on top.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. A short line down, then a dot. That is i!

parent_line: Can recognise the letters k and i, say their sounds and trace them.
